content.short: io.net is a decentralized DePIN on Solana that provides massive GPU compute power for AI and machine learning.
content.description:
io.net is a revolutionary Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) built on Solana, designed to provide high-performance GPU compute power for AI and machine learning applications. By aggregating idle GPU capacity from independent data centers, crypto miners, and other networks, io.net creates a massive, accessible cloud that is significantly more cost-effective than centralized providers. This decentralized approach ensures that developers can access the compute power needed for complex AI operations without the high costs or limited availability of traditional cloud services.

Leveraging the Solana blockchain for sub-second settlement and low-cost rewards, io.net ensures transparent and efficient interactions between compute providers and users. The network is powered by the $IO token, which facilitates governance, utility payments, and incentive coordination. As a foundational layer for the decentralized AI economy, io.net is empowering the next generation of builders with globally accessible and affordable computing resources.
